# Q1 2025 Product Metrics

## Summary

This report covers product performance for the first quarter of 2025. Growth
was strong across all key indicators, with active users and revenue both
exceeding quarterly targets.

## Metrics Table

| Metric          | January | February | March  |
|-----------------|---------|----------|--------|
| Active Users    | 12,400  | 13,800   | 15,200 |
| New Sign-ups    | 1,200   | 1,450    | 1,700  |
| Churn Rate      | 2.1%    | 1.9%     | 1.8%   |
| Revenue ($k)    | 84      | 91       | 103    |
| Support Tickets | 340     | 310      | 285    |

## Key Findings

- Active user growth accelerated in March, reaching 15,200 monthly active users.
- Churn rate declined for the third consecutive month, now at 1.8%.
- Revenue exceeded Q1 targets by 8%, driven by enterprise upsells.
- Support ticket volume fell 16% over the quarter, indicating improved product
  stability.

## Regional Breakdown

| Region        | Users  | Revenue ($k) |
|---------------|--------|--------------|
| North America | 7,800  | 62           |
| Europe        | 4,600  | 28           |
| Asia-Pacific  | 2,800  | 13           |

## Action Items

1. Expand marketing spend to retain Q1 momentum heading into Q2.
2. Investigate remaining churn drivers in the enterprise segment.
3. Plan Q2 infrastructure capacity for anticipated user growth.
4. Publish a support knowledge base to continue reducing ticket volume.
